description:
Fetch the list of seller offers for an Amazon product: every merchant selling the item with their price, shipping cost, condition (new/used), fulfillment type (FBA/FBM), and seller rating. Also returns the Buy Box winner. This is the tool for competitive price analysis, reseller monitoring, and availability tracking.

Use this tool when the question is about WHO sells the product and at WHAT price. If you need the product's own details (title, images, rating), use get_product_detail instead.

Each requested page costs 1 credit. Start with a single page (default) and only increase max_page if the user needs the full offer list. Use the condition and shipping filters to narrow results instead of paginating — it is cheaper.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number — a 10-character alphanumeric product identifier (e.g. B0CJB6V2L5). Found in the product URL after /dp/ or /gp/product/.

condition.description: Filter offers by item condition. Omit to include all conditions.

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain extension. Determines the regional Amazon site the data is fetched from. Use the domain that matches the user's market — prices, availability and rankings differ across marketplaces.

free_shipping.description: If true, return only offers with free shipping.

max_page.description: Ending page number. Each page costs 1 credit; max 5 pages per request. Default 1.

prime.description: If true, return only Prime-eligible offers.

name: get_product_offers
